speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I understand you are experiencing swelling in your right knee and have a family history of similar problems. To begin, can you describe exactly how this swelling started and what activities were you doing when it happened?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Not yet determined. Given the age (18 months), spontaneous swelling after minor activity, and family history, I need to know if the child has a limp, fever, or night pain, and I must request X-rays of the right knee. REQUEST TEST: Knee_X_Ray. REQUEST IMAGES.
